text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Waheeey! ♪

text_block_list.name: Young Woman
text_block_list.text: Helios! You gonna introduce us to<n>your new friend?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Yup! This is T-Rain. We're besties! ☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I mean, we made eye contact! Plus,<n>we're
breathing the same air, aren't<n>we? ☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Oh! Aw yeah! This song is such a<n>bop! Let's dance!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Like this! Just ride the rhythm... and<n>kinda sway
your bod! The rest is all<n>vibes!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
You're either a party animal or a<n>party pooper! Or
something like that.<n>Just follow my lead if you get
lost!<n>Otherwise, you'll kill the vibe.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
If the vibes die, then she might get<n>bored of me and
stop listening.<n>Besides, when in Rome...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Sheesh! That's more like it! Loving<n>the energy,
T-Rain! Let's go, Team<n>Tracen!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And so, I find myself caught up in<n>Helios's
antics—or rather, jumping<n>into them myself.

text_block_list.name: Shopper A
text_block_list.text:
And get this—you know our usual<n>social? We
decided at the last council<n>meeting to do a little
picnic potluck!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Go off! Leave the bitter stuff to<n>me—my cooking is
so fire it burns! ☆

text_block_list.name: Shopper A
text_block_list.text:
Ha ha, I see what you're saying! A<n>little char is
just seasoning, isn't it?<n>Honestly, every day has
been so<n>much fun since you showed up,<n>Helios.

text_block_list.name: Shopper B
text_block_list.text:
Not to mention how much you've<n>helped with the
neighborhood<n>council's outreach. Tons of people
are planning on coming to the picnic!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Slaaay! Let's take over a park—no, a<n>stadium! We
gotta make the stadium<n>picnic challenge go viral! ☆

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Truuue! ☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
...And then, we can lay out a buncha<n>blow-up pools
to make a beach for all<n>the seniors! Are you down?
I'm<n>down!

text_block_list.name: Old Man
text_block_list.text:
He he, that sure does sound fun. It<n>looks like
summer won't be leaving<n>this old geezer behind
this year.

text_block_list.name: Little Kid
text_block_list.text:
Helios! Me too! I'm gonna bring all<n>my friends from
daycare! Hee hee!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Waheeey! Everyone's welcome! ☆<n>Every person
on Earth is a bestie to<n>me!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Helios is always surrounded by<n>smiles, and it must
be because she's<n>always smiling herself.
choice_data_list: (She really loves fun from the bottom of her heart.)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ahh, what a great day! Got my daily<n>dose of
funsies! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I've been able to learn a bit about<n>Helios today.
She's as bright and<n>cheery as the sun, drawing
tons of<n>people into her orbit.
choice_data_list: (But I still can't tell how she feels about running.)

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
There must be some kind of reason<n>why a girl who
loves raw fun as<n>much as her would choose to
attend<n>Tracen Academy—some kind of<n>passion.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Aight, last thing for today! Race time!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Sup! 'Kay, let's do this! ☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Whazzat? That sounds so hard to<n>say—I'm weak!
choice_data_list: Didn't you just run a scrimmage yesterday?
Didn't you just run a scrimmage yesterday?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, but how am I supposed to end<n>a day without
running? You gotta<n>close out with the funnest thing!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Duh! Today was a lifetime of fun, but<n>racing is the
goat!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I get to go hard, harder, and hardest!<n>My heart pops
off! Everyone's crazy<n>pumped! And it feels super
good! ☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wait... Say sike! You don't know how<n>fun racing
is?! No shot you'd ask<n>why if you did!

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, we're all ready on our end.<n>Take your place
already, Helios.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
...Aight. ☆ Hey! I'm gonna carry T-Rain<n>over here
during the race, 'kay?

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text: Huuuh?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Wooooooo! Let's goooooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Helios swoops down, and next thing I<n>know, I'm
lifted into a piggyback hold.<n>Before I can resist, the
race starts<n>and Helios breaks into a full-pelt run!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! That's the point! Just feelthis! This! Is! The! Beeeeest!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Spurred on by her laughter, I find the<n>courage to
open my eyes... and feel<n>the wind, her movements,
breaths,<n>footsteps, and heartbeat. It all hits me<n>at
once!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ayyyy! Isn't this peak?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
What else could ever hit this hard?! I<n>love racing! I
lovey-dovey wub<n>raciiing!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: She doesn't not care about losing.She just wants to enjoy running withall her being. She loves racing fromthe heart!
choice_data_list: (Her running is so free... and radiant.)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: And I'm last place again?! Boohoo!
choice_data_list: I think it's because you were carrying me.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Same! ☆ But I still had a great time!<n>See, isn't racing
peak?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, I was too busy desperately<n>clinging on
for my life to enjoy most<n>of it, but I managed to
figure out how<n>she feels—and how I feel, too.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Once I cast away my preconceptionsof what a runner should be, I face hersincere emotions, brighter than theshining sun and freer than a flowingmelody.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
But that almost makes her lack of<n>ambition more
disappointing. She<n>doesn't know the depth of joy a
victory can bring.
choice_data_list: (I'm sure there's even more fun waiting for her.)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hey, let's go again! I won't carry<n>anyone this time!
C'mon, please?!

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text: Huh?! No way! You know mostpeople don't even do this two days ina row, right?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Mmkay, then. T-Rain, I choose you!<n>Let's scrim!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Racing was fun, right?! Now it's your<n>turn to catch
these hands! ☆ Woo,<n>let's hit the gates!
